T: Please look after this bear. And feed him marmalade.
D: A polite young bear from Darkest Peru arrives in London looking for a home.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington takes one out from under his hat.
S: the one he keeps under his hat
Thick white bread buttered right to the edges, spread with a coarse-cut orange marmalade, crusts left on, cut into squares and wrapped in baking paper.
cake and cocoa at the antique shop

Small slices of rich Dundee fruit cake with currants, sultanas and orange zest, topped with whole almonds in circles and baked slowly until golden. Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar until light, add 3 eggs one at a time, then fold in 200g plain flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and the zest of an orange. Spread in a lined 20cm round tin, arrange 50g whole almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin and cut into small slices.

Golden baked pastries filled with beef mince, onion, cumin, paprika, raisins and green olives, with a zingy coriander and lime dipping sauce. Fry 400g beef mince with a diced onion until browned. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 40g raisins and 50g chopped green olives and cook 5 minutes, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust, fill, fold and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander with 3 tbsp mayo, lime juice and a little jalapeno for dipping.
M: Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, tomato and Worcestershire under a golden crust of buttery mash, served with buttered peas. Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Tip into a baking dish. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and a splash of milk and spread over, roughing up the top with a fork. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 300g peas tossed in 20g butter.
Darkest Peru roast chicken and green sauce
the jungle in Peru where he grew up

Chicken marinated in garlic, cumin, paprika, lime and soy, roasted until the skin crackles, with a creamy coriander and jalapeno sauce and crispy potatoes. Blitz 4 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp oil. Rub over 1.5kg chicken pieces and marinate overnight. Roast at 200C for 45 minutes. Toss 1kg chunked potatoes in oil and salt and roast alongside for 45 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a jalapeno, 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp grated parmesan and lime juice for the green sauce.
W: Buttered bread spread with marmalade, layered in a dish, covered in a custard of eggs, milk and cream, rested 20 minutes, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Mr Gruber's orange cocoa with cream

Rich cocoa whisked into hot milk with orange zest and a pinch of salt, poured into china cups and topped with softly whipped cream. Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a smooth paste. Add 1L milk, the zest of an orange and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming but not boiling. Strain into four china cups. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each with a sprinkle of extra zest.
